title: APPROVE THE RIGHT-OF-WAY CONTRACTS FOR THE SCHUYLER HEIM BRIDGE PROJECT

Summary
: Staff requests approval of the Right-of-Way Contracts (Contracts) and associated easement deeds between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) and California Department of Transportation (Caltrans), to effect Caltrans’ acquisition of property rights over parcels owned by the Harbor Department, and parcels jointly owned by the Harbor Department and City of Long Beach Harbor Department (collectively Joint Ports), for the completed SR-47 Schuyler Heim Bridge Replacement and Expressway Project (SR-47 Project). Approval of the Contracts and associated easement deeds is in alignment with Strategic Plan Objective 1: World Class Infrastructure that Promotes Growth. Under the Contracts, Caltrans will acquire the required property rights for a total of $4,455,500, which represents fair market value based on appraisals and legal standards for determining just compensation inclusive of negotiated retroactive date of value.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(f) and Article III Class 5(30) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve the Right-of-Way Contracts between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department and California Department of Transportation in the amount of $4,455,500; 3) approve the easement deeds; 4) authorize the Executive Director to execute any instruments necessary to memorialize the transfer of permanent and temporary easement rights (e.g., easement deeds); and 5) adopt Resolution No. ___________.
